title: BPSK Demodulator Baseband
text: Demodulate BPSK-modulated data, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Noise variance} sets Noise Variance; {Decision type}, {Noise variance source}, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the phase of zeroth point, {Output data type} and {Derotate factor}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: BPSK-modulated baseband signal scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: Noise Variance positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Decision type
params.values: Decision type Hard decision (default) | Log-likelihood ratio | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance
params.values: Noise Variance 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Phase of zeroth point 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single |...

params.name: Derotate factor
params.values: Derotate factor Same word length as input (default) | Specify word length
